The Gilneas Brigade is one army of the Alliance in the Broken Isles, moving against the Burning Legion and Sylvanas Windrunner's forces under King Genn Greymane's command. The army comprises of Gilneans, both human and worgen, though are seen with dwarven aid in Stormheim. It is part of the Gilnean military. Whether this Brigade has any connection to the one from the Third War is unclear.

to the Lighthouse.]] The Gilnean Coast is the region in which the Battle for Gilneas battleground takes place. Players' minimaps will list this area when not in a specific subzone such as the Waterworks or Mines, typically when passing through the road beneath the Overlook.

The Gilnean Stronghold is the starting point for the Alliance players in the Battle for Gilneas battleground, and their headquarters on the Gilnean Coast. It possesses a graveyard that will always remain in Alliance possession throughout the game. The main area is walled off with several buildings inside and a gate, as well as a well and several other objects. There is also another building outside of the walls. The Stronghold is closest to the Lighthouse base, which is often the first to be captured by the Alliance.

Gilblingle is a gilgoblin found at Gurboggle's Ledge in Kelp'thar Forest. He is the cousin of the self-proclaimed gilgoblin king, King Gurboggle. Gurboggle threatened and harassed Gilblingle to no end in an attempt to obtain his family treasure, but ultimately Gilblingle couldn't take it anymore, and so decided to bury the treasure and feed the treasure map to Blackfin.

The Gilded Fan is a marsh found just west of New Cifera along the northern edge of the Valley of the Four Winds. The fan is fed by waters coming from the north, and further feeds the Gilding Stream. West of the glade is Cattail Lake. Kracor, a large crane, watches over her flock at the center of the marsh.

The Gilding Stream is a small river that runs south from the Gilded Fan, past Halfhill, the Silken Fields, and the Plain of Thieves, then connects with the Yan-Zhe River in central Valley of the Four Winds.

The Gift of the Ancients is found at in a small cave above the Sunset Shore in southwestern Talador. The path to the cave is marked by two unmanned fishing boats in the water next to a trail leading uphill. In the cave, three statues are facing away from a center dais. Interact with each statue twice to have them face the center. Once all three statues are pointing inward, beams of light come out from the statue's heads to the center dais, and the Gift of the Ancients appears. Loot the chest to acquire the Signet Ring of Gehs'taal.

The Gift of N'Zoth is a special cosmetic modification that makes you appear with a third eye on the head, that was added with the Crucible of Storms Xal'atath questline. It is acquired in Twist the Knife and can be removed in His Eye Upon You, but keeping it will allow you to unlock additional dialogs with many NPCs, receive whispers and even understand the Shath'Yar language.
Gilnean Steed is a horse located in Gilneas and Elwynn Forest.
Gild Crewneck is a vrykul located in Valdisdall in Stormheim. He provides Gild's Crewneck for free.
Gild's Crewneck is provided for free by Gild Crewneck in Valdisdall in Stormheim during Free T-Shirt Day. The rest of the year, it can be purchased for from Skin-Me-Own-Coat Dibblefur in Booty Bay.
__NOTOC__ Giblin Clockspark is a gnome located in Mugamba Overlook in Zuldazar.

Gift Research Facility: Omicron is a Blingtron facility in an unknown location. At one point during the ongoing War, Peacekeeper 014 units at the facility were attacked by unidentified threats, leading to the initiation of protocol 54. This was followed by a similar attack on Gift Research Facility: Iota.

Gift Research Facility: Iota is a Blingtron facility in an unknown location. At one point during the ongoing War, Peacekeeper 014 units at the facility were attacked by unidentified threats. This led to the termination of protocol 54 (which had been initiated after the attack on Gift Research Facility: Omicron) in favor of protocol 87, and orders were given to "maintain quarantine until further notice".
The Gilded Triumvirate Chest is a chest located in the armor of the Seat of the Triumvirate.

Gillvanas is the Horde murloc companion given out to attendees for BlizzCon 2019. It is modeled after Sylvanas Windrunner. It occasionally summons Kevinos. She can be seen fighting the forces of Deathwingurlugull in Azmerloth.
Gilded-Wing Shoulderguards drop from Doom's Howl in the Arathi Highlands.
